description: Project-aware design-pattern and architecture guidance using your Codex model, with transparent local safety and quality hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Suggest project-fit patterns and guide architecture decisions
interface.longDescription:
Review a current project, suggest and compare suitable design patterns and architecture styles, explain patterns with stored Python examples, record durable decisions, prepare coding handoffs, and review architecture conformance. The selected Codex model chooses the smallest sufficient workflow from each request. The short-lived local hooks add deterministic activation and continuation guidance, a fixed budget-limited read-only snapshot command for efficient small-repository evidence, static-inspection and application-code write guardrails, typed architecture-bundle validation before and after persistence, minimal compaction recovery, visible option-rendering validation, and protection against leaked internal response markers. They make no model or network calls, start no persistent process, do not bypass Codex permissions, and persist no prompt, tool argument, response, or repository content. Their exact definitions, source, and tests are available through the public project repository.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: ACTIVATE ALL FIVE BUNDLED HOOKS BEFORE FIRST USE. All five hooks are required for reliable routing, continuation, safety checks, validated architecture-artifact creation, and complete user-facing responses.
defaultPrompt: Suggest suitable design patterns for my current project.
Give me Python examples of Abstract Factory.
Compare suitable architectures for this project.
